_meta.owner_team: council-architecture + council-security + council-legal + ops-sre-reliability + ops-compliance + axis-observability
_meta.purpose: Canonical machine-readable per-compliance-pack DR floor table. Consumed by the pack-activation gate Cedar fragments and the auditor dashboard auto-generation tooling. Effective tenant RTO/RPO per (tenant, microservice) pair = MIN over microservice-declared and all-applicable-pack floors (stringency partial order; smaller seconds = stricter). Multi-region requirement = OR over microservice-declared and all-applicable-pack mr_required flags. Drill cadence = SHORTEST cadence across microservice tier-default and all-applicable-pack drill_cadence_required. Per ADR-0343 §D-4 algorithm.

industry_citations.convention: per-pack control evidence + per-application DR posture

_meta.stringency_algorithm: effective.rto_p99_seconds = MIN(M.rto, MIN over applicable P_i.rto). effective.rpo_p99_seconds = MIN(M.rpo, MIN over applicable P_i.rpo). effective.multi_region_active_active = M.mr OR (OR over applicable P_i.mr_required). effective.drill_cadence = SHORTEST cadence across M.cadence_default and all P_i.drill_cadence_required.

version.description: Semantic version per semver 2.0. Major bump on floor stringency increase; minor on additive refinement (process_floors, data_class_floors); patch on editorial only.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical CBOR-encoded table body (excluding the signature field). Lowercase hex; 128 chars = 64 bytes.

standard_version.description: Precise external standard revision backing this pack floor when pack_id remains a stable major-version shorthand. For PCI-DSS-L1-v4 this records 4.0.1.

source_revision.description: Source/version acquisition metadata for the floor's external standard citation; this is not readiness, certification, or evidence-acceptance proof.

rto_p99_seconds.description: Upper bound on p99 recovery-time-objective in whole seconds.

rpo_p99_seconds.description: Upper bound on p99 recovery-point-objective in whole seconds. 0 = no data loss tolerated (active-active or synchronous replication).

multi_region_required.description: Pack-mandated multi-region active-active or active-passive cross-region topology.

process_floors.description: SOX-404 per-process refinement. Keyed by canonical SOX in-scope process name. Each value is a dr_floor sub-block.

data_class_floors.description: KR-PIPA per-data-class refinement. Keyed by data-class identifier from ADR-0099 registry. Each value is a dr_floor sub-block.

_meta.rationale: HIPAA Contingency Plan §164.308(a)(7) requires emergency-mode operation for PHI-handling systems. Customary BAA-eligible provider interpretation is ≤ 1h RTO with multi-region active-active or active-passive topology to preserve patient care continuity during major-region failure. 5-minute RPO reflects the regulator's expectation that PHI loss is minimized; continuous replication is standard. Quarterly testing is the customary baseline matching §164.308(a)(7)(ii)(D) testing-and-revision-procedures.

source_revision.claim_ceiling: DR floor source-version metadata only; no PCI DSS Level 1 readiness, v4.0.1 control completeness, ROC/AOC/QSA/ASV readiness, or tenant CDE activation claim.

PCI DSS v4.0.1 §12.10.1 (Documented business continuity / disaster recovery — exact row text pending permitted official PDF acquisition)

PCI DSS v4.0.1 §11.3 (Network-layer segmentation — cardholder data environment; exact row text pending permitted official PDF acquisition)

_meta.rationale: PCI DSS v4.0.1 source-version reconciliation keeps the stable PCI-DSS-L1-v4 floor id while requiring exact source-row acquisition before evidence acceptance. 24h RTO + 1h RPO remains a planning DR floor for backup-restore within a documented business-continuity policy. Per-region active-active topology is NOT mandated by this planning floor itself; tenants requiring tighter availability compose PCI with SOC2 or ISO 27001 floors. Annual testing remains the planned cadence, but exact §12.10.2 text must be reconciled after permitted official PDF acquisition.

regulator_citations: AICPA SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria — Availability category
SOC 2 Common Criteria CC7.5 (System recovery)
SOC 2 Common Criteria CC9.2 (Vendor and business partner risk management — DR provisions)
AICPA SOC 2 Type II Audit Guide — system recovery objectives + annual testing
AICPA TSP Section 100 (2017 + 2022 updates)
_meta.rationale: SOC 2 Type II demands tested system recovery without prescribing a specific RTO/RPO. 4h / 15min floor reflects the customary baseline for SaaS providers seeking SOC 2 Type II audit reports across the SaaS industry (Stripe, Linear, Notion, Vercel-class baselines). Multi-region NOT required by SOC 2 itself; many SOC 2-attested SaaS providers operate single-region active-passive with documented runbooks and annual DR drills.

regulator_citations: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act)
EU AI Act Annex III (High-risk AI systems list)
EU AI Act Article 9 (Risk management system)
EU AI Act Article 14 (Human oversight)

_meta.rationale: High-risk AI systems under EU AI Act Annex III (biometric identification, critical infrastructure, education, employment, essential services, law enforcement, migration, justice + democratic process) face fundamental-rights impact assessment. Unavailability creates a fundamental-rights gap. 30-minute RTO + 5-minute RPO + multi-region floor reflects the regulator's expectation of continuous operation for high-risk systems. Quarterly drill cadence matches the Article 17 quality management system continuity testing pattern.

regulator_citations: Korea CSAP (Cloud Security Assurance Program) v3.1 §3.5.1 (BCP/DR control objective)

K-ISMS-P certification framework (cross-reference)
_meta.rationale: CSAP-Korea is the canonical Korean public-sector cloud security certification. 1h RTO + 15min RPO + multi-region within KR sovereign region reflects KISA's expectation. Multi-region must remain within the KR sovereign perimeter per ADR-0240 sovereign-cloud constraints. Semi-annual drill cadence is the customary CSAP-certified cloud service baseline.

_meta.rationale: ISO 27001:2022 Annex A.5.30 introduced explicit ICT-readiness-for-business-continuity control. ISO 22301 provides the BCM framework. 4h / 1h floor reflects the customary baseline for ISO 27001-certified information security management systems. Multi-region NOT required by ISO 27001 itself; certified ISMSs may operate single-region with documented BCM and tested annually.

general_ledger_journal_entry.rationale: General ledger journal entries are SOX-404 sharpest financial-process objective. 1-minute RPO preserves close-cycle continuity; 7-year retention matches IRS + SEC retention norms.

revenue_recognition.rationale: Revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15 requires consistent and durable record of revenue events. 15-minute RPO preserves period-end accuracy.

vendor_master_data.rationale: Vendor master data changes infrequently; 24h RTO + 1h RPO is sufficient.

quarterly_close_working_papers.rationale: Quarterly close working papers must survive audit cycle; 7-year retention covers SEC retention requirements.

Sarbanes-Oxley Act §302 (Corporate Responsibility for Financial Reports)
Sarbanes-Oxley Act §906 (Corporate Responsibility for Financial Reports — certification)

IRS Publication 583 (Recordkeeping for Business)
_meta.rationale: SOX-404 is process-oriented; financial-process availability is the audit objective. Per-process refinement allows microservices to satisfy each in-scope process's specific floor without over-paying. The in-scope process list is owned by the auditor sponsoring SOX scope and may evolve quarterly. Default fallback floor applies when no process-specific floor is declared.

PI_KR_RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER.rationale: RRN (주민등록번호) compromise carries criminal-class regulator response under PIPA §59. Multi-region required within KR sovereign region. 1-hour RTO + 5-minute RPO matches the strictest PIPA enforcement posture.

PI_KR_SENSITIVE.rationale: PIPA sensitive personal information (§23: ideology, beliefs, union membership, political opinions, health, sex life, criminal history, biometric, genetic data) requires enhanced safeguards but not multi-region per pack alone.

PI_KR_PIPA.rationale: General personal information under PIPA receives the default pack floor.

PIPA Article 21 (Destruction of personal information)

_meta.rationale: PIPA §29 imposes safeguards per personal-information data class. RRN compromise carries criminal-class regulator response under §59; floor for RRN-touching microservices is tighter than general PI. Per-data-class refinement allows microservices touching only general PI to declare a more lenient contract.
